title: General RRCRelease
text: The purpose of this procedure is: a) to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers (except for broadcast MRBs), BH RLC channels, Uu Relay RLC channels as well as all radio resources;   or   b) to suspend the RRC connection   only if SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB, SRB2, are setup, which includes the suspension of the established radio bearers.
